$comment: English display overlay for the labels (§218) of this package of the Constitution of the Republic of Kazakhstan (DECISION-0070). The file is not compiled into the CLIR and is read only by the presentation layer (verbalize --labels, the MCP resource law://<package>/verbalized/en, the workbench). The translation is a working one made by the formaliser from the Russian labels of the package, checked against the authentic Russian and Kazakh texts of the Constitution; it is not an official publication, hence the status "translation" for every entry. Spelling is British. A key is the local name of the declaration (the part of the node id after "#").
